Risk Statement: Users may retain excessive access beyond job role requirements, increasing unauthorized access risk.
Recommended Treatment: Perform role-based access review and remove unnecessary permissions.

Risk Statement: Privileged accounts may not be sufficiently separated, monitored, or reviewed.
Recommended Treatment: Separate admin accounts, require MFA, and review privileged groups.
Evidence Needed: Admin group export, MFA evidence, review notes

Risk Statement: Insufficient segmentation may allow lateral movement between user, server, admin, remote access, and DMZ zones.
Vulnerability: Flat or poorly documented network zones
Recommended Treatment: Define zones and restrict inter-zone traffic using deny-by-default rules.
Evidence Needed: Network diagram, firewall rules, VLAN list

Risk Statement: Incomplete SIEM/logging coverage may prevent detection of suspicious authentication, network, endpoint, or administrative activity.
Recommended Treatment: Onboard critical authentication, firewall, endpoint, and administrative logs.
Evidence Needed: SIEM log source list, sample alerts, review records

Risk Statement: Backup and restore procedures may fail during an incident if not regularly tested and documented.
Recommended Treatment: Conduct scheduled restore tests and retain evidence.
